dependency_rules.reason: plan 1.3: CalcFunc cannot depend on CalcFml, CalcEngine or CalcHost
plan 1.3: CalcFml cannot depend on CalcEngine, CalcHost or the CalcDoc codec
plan 1.3: CalcEngine may depend on the CalcDoc model, never its codec, the applications or the skins
plan 1.3: OneCalc's transitive dependency closure contains no CalcEngine or CalcHost
plan 1.3: skins depend on the skin contract and controller layer, never engine internals

plan 1.3 and 2.1: CalcEngine may depend on CalcDoc's neutral model, and the model depends only on the CalcFunc value types and service contracts, never on CalcEngine, CalcFml, CalcHost or the CalcDoc codec

plan 10.1 and infra-m1.1: the portable verdict library depends on neither calc-func (the function library whose results it judges) nor any CalcFml, CalcEngine, CalcHost, CalcDoc or application package, so the code under test is never part of its own judge; calc-value supplies its value types
